data.rationale: jcv_floor needs to know that jcv_real_to_int returns the truncated integer value in order to prove that floor(v) <= v and floor(v) > v - 1. Without knowing the relationship between input and output, WP cannot prove these bounds.

jcv_ceil needs to know that jcv_real_to_int returns the integer truncation of v (floor for positive, ceiling for negative) in order to prove its ceiling semantics postconditions: ensures \\result >= v; and ensures \\result - 1 < v;
